classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied altitude, right-angle marker and half-base length to find the shorter side of the indicated right triangle.

content.prompt: $ABC$ is an equilateral triangle with side length $2$. $X$ is the midpoint of $AC$. Find the length $BX$.

spec.description: Equilateral ABC with midpoint X, dashed red altitude BX, right-angle marker at X, BC labelled 2 and XC labelled 1. All letters retained because the stem names the triangle, midpoint segment and requested altitude.
spec.mathematics: BC=2, XC=1, BX perpendicular to AC; BX is a shorter side of right triangle BXC.
